verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is an API product, so API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The items only describe the Tax Calculations and Transactions APIs' functionality and confirm that llms.txt, an MCP server and a CLI exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
